aboutText: B&D Concreting is based in Newport, proudly serving Altona, Williamstown, and across Melbourne's west. With over 25 years of experience in all types of concrete work, we specialise in domestic, industrial, and commercial projects. From exposed aggregate driveways to concrete slabs, our team delivers quality craftsmanship every time. Trust your local Newport concreters for reliable and professional service.
servicesText: We offer a comprehensive range of concreting services for homes and businesses across Newport and surrounding suburbs. From plain concrete to decorative exposed aggregate, we handle everything from footpaths to foundations with expertise and care.

services.desc: Expert plain concrete solutions for driveways, slabs, and general use across Newport and surrounding areas.
